pages.lesson:
LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: SPELLING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Writing 3.2 Guided writing: Handwriting (2 sessions) • Neatness and legibility •
Topic 3.4: Guided Writing: Spelling
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing: Spelling, part of Writing 3.2 Guided writing: Handwriting (2 sessions) • Neatness and legibility • in Grade 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why should we spell words correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify days of the week with peers,

2. fish out letters from a collection of jumbled up letters to form days of the week,

3. engage in a dictation session to list days of the week using correct spelling,

4. complete language puzzles relating to days of the week,

5. match letters to form words from a given collection of words about days of the week

6. rearrange jumbled words to make meaningful sentences on days of the week in groups.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify days of the week with peers,
2. fish out letters from a collection of jumbled up letters to form days of the week,
3. engage in a dictation session to list days of the week using correct spelling,
4. complete language puzzles relating to days of the week,
5. match letters to form words from a given collection of words about days of the week
6. rearrange jumbled words to make meaningful sentences on days of the week in groups.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing: Spelling together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Critical thinking and problem solving: This is promoted as the learner considers possible choices when fishing out letters from a

collection of jumbled up letters to form days of the week.

Values:
Social justice: This is enhanced as the learner gives peers equal opportunities when completing language puzzles relating to days

of the week.

accomplish group tasks.
